messages.subject: New Stan Lectures Online
parts:
My old lectures from the Machine Learning Summer School have been pretty
popular amongst many Stan users, but they suffer from two issues: firstly I was
deathly sick and the second is that we’ve learned a whole bunch in the meantime!
I have been giving similar but updated talks over the past few years, and fortunately
my talks last week were recorded and are now online.

HMC: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VnNdhsm0rJQ
Some Modeling Techniques: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uSjsJg8fcwY

Hope they prove helpful!

-Mike Betancourt
